title: Alicia Dieujuste on Dental Software, AI, and Practice Management
html:
In this episode of Speaking of Dentistry: The Editor’s Cut, Stan Goff, Senior Managing Editor of Dentistry Today, interviews Alicia Dieujuste, Managing Director of DentiMax, about the evolution of dental practice management software and how technology can help dental teams work more efficiently.

Drawing on more than two decades of experience in dentistry, Dieujuste discusses her journey from dental consulting and software training to leadership at DentiMax. She shares insights into DentiMax Flow, cloud-based practice management software, and the company’s ongoing efforts to address everyday challenges in dental offices.

Topics include AI-powered voice periodontal charting, voice-activated clinical charting, insurance eligibility automation, claims processing, dental imaging, and emerging technology designed to streamline workflows and save time for dental teams.

In this interview:

  • Alicia Dieujuste’s background in dental consulting and practice management
  • DentiMax Flow and the evolution of dental software
  • AI and voice-activated periodontal charting
  • Automating insurance eligibility and claims workflows
  • Dental imaging technology and practice efficiency
  • How software innovation can help dental teams improve daily operations

Presented by: DentiMax

  • Guest: Alicia Dieujuste, Managing Director, DentiMax
  • Interviewer: Stan Goff, Senior Managing Editor of Dentistry Today
